notes.title: It's Almost Time!
notes.notes:
[i][b]Are you ready for a new journey?[/b][/i]

Always a New Journey is nearly ready for early access!

Although I don't have much to share yet, the game has undergone many reworks to prepare for early access testing.

For now, I have started a community discord where I will start posting screenshots within the next few days. You can find it [url=https://discord.gg/8HHVnncS9k]here.[/url]
